prompt: Security fix in backend/internal/session: POST /v1/ingest reads whatever path the request names. CodeQL flagged user-controlled paths reaching Stat and ReadFile. Confine ingest to the process's working directory: resolve the request's path relative to the cwd, and answer 400 Bad Request for an absolute path outside it, any path that escapes with ../, and the path ".." itself. Ingesting files and directories inside the cwd keeps working as before.

Two fixes to draft analysis in the backend. First: when the model's analysis JSON cannot be parsed (invalid JSON or trailing content), the analyze endpoint must answer 422 with body {"error":"unparseable_model"} and leave the draft untouched. Add kernel.ErrUnparseable (its message is "unparseable_model") and have the OpenRouter coach adapter return it, still wrapping kernel.ErrUnavailable so existing callers behave the same. Second: exemplars are style samples, not evidence. A fact flag's evidence may only cite attached sources; exemplars appear only in style notes. Citation locators stay the analyze response contract.

The local platform server in backend/internal/platform loses every document on restart. Make it run on durable SQLite: add a DBPath field to platform.Config, defaulting to manthan/manthan.db under the user config directory (fall back to manthan.db when that is unavailable) and overridable with the MANTHAN_DB_PATH environment variable. A document created through one server built with NewWithConfig must still be readable after srv.Close() and a new NewWithConfig on the same DBPath.
